prompt: Here's a `FeedService.getFeed(userId)` from a social feed that uses a hybrid fan-out strategy: ordinary authors are fanned out on write, but posts from KOLs (high-follower accounts) are merged in at read time. The team added a per-KOL Redis cache with a 60-second TTL specifically so repeated reads within that window would skip Postgres — but in production the feed still feels DB-heavy, and it gets noticeably worse for users who follow a lot of KOLs. Walk me through the code and tell me why the cache isn't buying anything, then tell me how you'd fix the read path.
